title: Offense and Defense Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Selective offense accompanies explicit macro uncertainty.
coverage_note: All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

claims.claim: Safe bank assets reduce crisis risk
claims.reason: Looking beyond regulatory capital is useful. But SVB demonstrated that government-backed securities can create duration and run risk when funded by concentrated uninsured deposits. The simple cash/Treasury-versus-loans classification missed important balance-sheet structure.

evidence.title: SVB review, key takeaways
evidence.finding: SVB failed after unmanaged interest-rate exposure, concentrated uninsured deposits and a rapid run; safe credit assets did not eliminate duration and liquidity risks.

framework_lessons: Separate business resilience from share-price volatility.
assessment: The article acknowledges uncertainty more clearly than a simple bullish/bearish label would suggest. Its preferred China bottom failed and the legislative reassurance missed the IRA. DHI remained operationally resilient while earnings fell. The bank-asset heuristic deserves particular scrutiny after SVB: low credit risk did not eliminate duration or funding risk.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
